observations: Photo 0 shows two car headlight assemblies, one above the other, placed on a tiled floor. Both have clear lenses with circular main bulbs and smaller auxiliary bulbs, and black plastic housings with mounting brackets. The top headlight has a slightly different lens shape and appears to be in better condition.

Photo 1 shows a front grille with a central Toyota emblem, black vertical slats, and a chrome trim. The grille is placed on a tiled floor, and the background includes a green object and part of a box with text, including 'CHINA' and 'CITI'.

The headlight assemblies in photo 0 appear to be from the same vehicle, possibly a Toyota Prado or similar SUV, based on design and size. The grille in photo 1 is a separate part, likely for the front of the same vehicle.
No visible model numbers, part numbers, or VINs are readable on any part in the photos.
The seller claims the parts are for a Prado Jeep and are in working condition.

claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition
claims.evidence: The grill and headlight assemblies in photo 0 and 1 are consistent with a Toyota Prado or similar SUV, but there is no visual proof of working condition. No power-on test or functional demonstration is shown.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Headlights may not be functional or may have internal damage (e.g., broken bulbs, loose wiring, or damaged lens).
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the headlights turned on, with clear illumination and no flickering or dead spots.

risks.risk: Grille may be damaged, cracked, or have missing parts (e.g., mounting brackets, trim pieces).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the grille edges, mounting points, and any visible cracks or missing components.

risks.risk: Parts may not fit the claimed vehicle model (e.g., not a Prado or may be for a different year or trim).
risks.proof: Photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the part number on the headlight or grille housing.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or battery compartment showing the model and year.
Video or photo of the headlights turned on to verify functionality.
Close-up photos of the grille mounting points and edges to check for damage or missing parts.
Photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or part number to confirm compatibility.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
